newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges up on Medan, Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges up on Medan, Tokyo.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark SIR20 offer prices edged higher in late trading on Tuesday on the back of talk of tighter supply in Thailand and higher prices in Medan and Tokyo, dealers said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries edged up 0.25 cents/lb to 55.75-56.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.25-55.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.75-55.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
"Sentiment remains firm, as deals in Medan, higher prices in Tokyo and talk of lower supply in Thailand due to rains prompt sellers to increase their offer prices," one dealer in Medan said.
Dealers said U.S. buying of SIR20 was heard at 55.50 cents/lb fob Medan November deliveries in the north Sumatran city of Medan after the lunch break.
SIR20 was previously traded at 55.00 in the west Sumatran city of Padang also November deliveries late on Monday, dealers said.
They said high amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,325-2,350 rupiah/kg in Bandung and Tangerang against the previous 2,425 rupiah/kg.
